book.title: LUK Apan Luk Iesu inak mega guturewa sen

content: Iesu amun mega noa

Wam da Iesu God Paewa gapan waenapan wadidiam wandin amba God Oit Mega Kakaewa opata taiwandini gapan pirisi bawarewa ge iup wadidiamuine nagire amba waenapan dimae waine nagirewa den Iesu ine tauan anega wane,
“Ge amun ansena da waran gapan dim dim mame taingi? Amun mame, da genen?”
Menan Iesu gare anega wadiamon, “Ne den singui inayap wayawaepen taivin.
Singui nega mam, apan Dion dup iamuiwandiniwa ame amun mega aupa kimani ware taiwandin go, gare mapa piupa waenapan upi inamup ware taiwandin?”
Singui mega anune muk wawa mutan anega wane, “Endi nu kiman amun mega ware taiwandat wata, me anega dianeta, ‘E dimen Dion nop mega ya anu tumasiwanin?’
Go nu endi anega watawa, ‘Amun waenapan inamup ware taiwandin,’ ap anega watawa, waenapan ma iragi gwara toguguranain iwa mu anun Dion me God watu eneni apanewa.”
Anega anuiwanumune menan Iesu singui mega garewa anega wadian, “Dion amun ame wareni arewa nu oare.”
Menan Iesu anega diamon, “Ap menan ne den amun nega amba warana gapan ugup ugup mame taina ya wadiain.”
Egak kwayup taine nagire maibewa
Iesu maibe gapan waenapan anega wadiamon, “Apan da nao egak mega da veren, amba amase taine nagire egak kwayup tapen menan semoni amba ae vemo at da ugup aen, en nononga di wande en.

Taba maup wamewa taueni gapan piup i apane nao mega apane da watu enen ae egak mega amase taine nagire inamup tauen, maup semua i apane wanapen menan mup wan. Go amase taine nagirewa to papaunagen wa oisene mondi aen.
Menan i apane, nao mega apane dawa sia watu enen tauen. Go sia to papaunagen me inap ta umamasene menan nao apane ame mondi aen.
Ap menan, nao i apane apan yampoa sia watu enen. Egak amase taine nagirewa me epi tosisitnagen warup uat enane tau aen.
Amba nao i apane anuan sese anega tan, ‘Ne map anenen tain? Ne otuna imuna inap warina watu enain. Anse, ne otuna yave viripewa tain go?’

Otua watu enen oniwandin e egak amase taine nagire paina yawan muk ase ma anega wawa mutan, ‘Piup i apane otua oniwan. Apan mam iman egak ma yon boreta, menan anet togurat boep, amba egak mame boge nu yon borat.’
Menan waran sin garip uat enan togurane boen.” Iesu ap anega wan. Amba Iesu anega singui wayawamon, “Ap tane menan piup i apane inamup anenen tamota?
Tave di, me taue egak amase taine nagirewa guramop borit wap, amba egak mega ware waenapan ugupewa munep kwayup tain.” Waenapan nop ame anune menan anega wan, “Akae, manega ya venasep, nu tanda!”
Ap wane menan, Iesu kem kem usenagaet yawamo anega wayawamon, “Go God nop mega ok mame anega seane iwa mega anenen wai?

content.text: Agim ame pa tuine nagirewa tandayasen, koerage dian,
go God agim ame ware entanen amba pa tuine danewa venasen.

content: Menan waenapan da da agim ame aigap onan geamopiwa, ame kaime no topait wa pait ta semuroro ta seta, go gare agim ame orup da aigap gearepiwa ame to gogotonagep atabobo venaseta.”
At i nagirewa moni seait go uon?

Iesu maibe mame waiwandini menan, pirisi bawarewa ge iup wadidiamuine nagire den Iesu ambot warapen menan negin yop taiwanumun. Iwa mu asigimup maibe ame mu koewa muga menan waiwandin. Go mu waenapan tamu anun menan Iesu evi amba to warat anun.

To warapen menan amat taiwanumune nagirewa, Iesu enu yawa wapen menan gopat nagirewa karaua moni munan amba Iesu inap watu enamon. Mu mondigawa nagirewa mini tan iwanumun go singui tangui gapan Iesu nop da wabambamasepiwa, ap gapan mu anu to ware amo, at ame bawarewa apanewa nani gwanap barain.

Ap menan, wam da, mu Iesu inap singui anega wayawan, “Wadianet nugawa, nu asiginup ge waenapan muk anen wane taine ame menan ge imuga potaga ya wariniwa, go ge nop tavewa gapan God dim dim anuini om ap gapan tainampen neginewa wadianianawa.
Menan nu singui nuga mam. At Rom ayopewa Sisa nu moni se wanata ame gapan nu Mosis iup mega yamatait go uon?”
Go mu nanamaset wan taiwanumune Iesu me asigip tan, menan me anega wan,
“Endi moni agim makewa da ewanegen. Yao, moni ame gamup da yaua o guewa ok seane?” Mu gare anega wan, “Ame ayop Sisa yaua ge guewa.”
Me sia wadiamon, “Ap menan, wan dim dim Sisa mega wandepi ame Sisa di wanapen. God mega wandepi, ame God di wanapen.”
Mu nop mega anune gapan gare tarak wan no uon wanumon. Waenapan namumup Iesu nop da anenen wa koeamep warapen menan tane go umap uon.
Borit wane nagirewa sia yon wanumoin
Amba dugup Sadusi nagire, upi Iesu inap tauan. Mu dugup anu tumat muga gapan waenapan manega wadidiam wanumun, “Borit wata sia ya inak nitait.”
Menan Iesu inap singui anega wayawan, “Wadianet nugawa, watageta apane Mosis nunan iup ogewa anega sen, ‘Apan da waenewa otu uon boepi gapan me gwaniwa kwapura ame naise tasewa uewa orup se wanep.’
Endi apan upi tatap gwanip yananewa nanin yamunaet yamunewa dere mugenat wanumon. Namu bonewa mugawa waen naiseni go me otu uon boen.
Menan gwaniwa ewap yaneni, tasewa kwapuraewa sia naiseni go otu uon boen.
Amba yampoa yaneni, waen ame naiseni go otu uon sia boen. Amba upinewa iragi ap anega tan orup ya sean amba borit wane.
Amba uiwa waen kwapura ame den sia boen.
Menan endi apan nanin yamunaet yamune dere waen ame naitanewa go wam uiwa gapan waenapan inak muse sia yon wanumopi waen ame apan ansenawa waenewa?”
Iesu nop ame gare anega wadiamon, “Endi waenapan naine musiwanum amba ore wai naine mutapen men muniwanum.
Go waenapan borit wane evi amba sia yon wanumopi inak yaibobot eviwa gapan mu gare gare ya naine mutain den ore wai naine mutapen menan ya munain.
Iwa mu anea umap wanumoin sia ya borit wain. Ame mu God otu waiwa iwa mu bop gapan God amun mega gapan sia yon wanumopi menan.
Borit wane nagirewa evi sia inak muse yon wanumopi ame tavewa apan Mosis ok namua seni gapan wa ewanen. Oma ut yagit wandin yaveni guturewa gapan ok anega sen,

content.text: God anega wan ‘Omae baewa Eibaraam, otua Aisik,
amba upewa Diekap, mu God muga daiton ame ne di.’

content: Nop ame gueguewa mam, waenapan kabaniwa ge bonigawa mu God yamap iravi kabani wanumamun, iwa mu guamu den.”
Iesu ap anega wani menan iup wadidiamuine nagire upi anega wan, “Wadianet nugawa, nop gega kakae di waan.”
Ap anega wane iwa mu tap tan inap singui sia ya wayawan.
God Keriso mega Iesu
Iesu singui Sadusi nagirewa anega wayawamon, “Anenen gapan God wa watu eneni Keriso mega me watageta apane Devit naewa?
Ame tave di, go? Iwa watageta bukaewa, yaua Sam, gapan Devit Keriso evi amba me denip gapan tauapen menan ok anega sen,

content.text: God yone Ayop anega wadien, ‘Nanina nutup arigewa gapan,
ae wanigingan, ne anavi gega tambup,

content: Nop ma gapan, Devit yone Keriso inap me Ayop diwandin go Devit namu yaneni apanewa amba Keriso evi yanen menan anenen entane Devit naewa mega ayop dien?” Iesu singui ap anega wan.
Iup wadidiamuine nagirewa koewa mugawa
Waenapan Iesu nop mega anuiwanumune gapan wadiamot mega sia anega wadiamon,

“God iup mega wadidiaine nagirewa munan ae yao kakayasen amba yon iwanian. Ian ame mondi yonane wanup kakae guragut enane, waenapan ase yawamopen menan apan apan tainewa, amba taba une taine arewa gapan amopi waenapan gaun munat anuiwanum. Amba den Diu opata waine paewa o barip gagewa gapan watat kakae iragena gagap wanumot anuiwanum.

Go mu waen kwapura kaimakaet enu yawamon wane gapan kwapura puraput ge pa mugawa den tambune. Ap tane go mup paewa gapan waenapan yamamup muk ingane tap kakae tapen menan, God inap mup wa nonongaminewa. Koewa ap tainewa menan wanene baware aigap yawain.” Iesu ap anega wan.
